about: Per-test time limit on the Windows CI shards (TAB-201), checked by scripts/test-timings.mjs --budget. The test timeout is 60 s; a test slower than half of it fails the job by name, so it is made cheaper before it becomes a flaky timeout. Set from five main runs (15 Windows samples per test, 2026-10-09): every test stayed under 23 s.
